# ACE Step

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a model-specific deep dive for StepFun-AI's open-weights music foundation model ACE Step on RunComfy: tag-driven composition (genre, mood, instruments), multilingual lyrics with section markers, 5 s to 4 min stereo output, at $0.0002–0.0003 per second — roughly 27× cheaper than ElevenLabs Music. Four CLI-reachable endpoints: ACE Step text-to-audio (default), ACE Step 1.5 text-to-audio (50+ language lyrics, refined structured-lyric handling), ACE Step audio-inpaint (regenerate a time range inside an existing track), ACE Step audio-outpaint (extend a track before or after). Complement to the meta-router prime-skills-ai-music: that one decides which model fits; this one is the full operating manual for ACE Step once chosen — pick ACE Step when cost dominates, pick ElevenLabs when vocal quality and commercial polish justify the premium.
